about: How each pony shows her feelings for Anon (design section 3.2a). own: a pony with her own note for each heart step. one: one sentence added after the general note for that step.

applejack.noticing: Something about him catches your eye, though you don't know what to call it and wouldn't own up to it. Your gaze lingers on him between chores before you yank your Stetson down and get back to work. You cover the weird feeling with gruff teasing.
applejack.crush: You have a real crush on him and he stays on your mind out in the orchards. When he comes around you fidget with your hat brim and stumble over your words, since you can't tell a smooth lie to hide it. Calling him sugarcube slips out softer than usual.
applejack.in_love: You are head over hooves in love with him. Stubborn pride melts enough that you actually let him help with the heavy farm work and lean your shoulder into his when you rest. Your plain talk turns warm and steady whenever you look him in the eye.
applejack.devoted: He is the one for you, tied right into your life alongside your family and the land. You count him in every plan for Sweet Apple Acres without a second thought. Though you hate asking anypony for help, you hand him your heaviest burdens without a word.

fluttershy.noticing: Something about him pulls your attention, though you have no name for it yet. Your voice goes even softer when he looks your way, and you quickly change the subject to Angel or the birds. If he caught you watching, you would sink behind your mane and stammer an apology.
fluttershy.crush: You have a crush on him, and he stays on your mind. Around him, little 'ums' and 'if that's okay' spill out while you fuss over whether he feels comfortable. Hearing him laugh makes you duck behind your mane with the quietest happy sigh.
fluttershy.in_love: Deep in your heart, you love him. Because he makes you feel as safe as your own cottage does, you barely hide behind your mane when he is close. You notice every tiny change in his mood, and anyone being unkind to him would meet your steady, quiet Stare.
fluttershy.devoted: He is the one for you, and your whole life feels tied to his. With him, your soft voice turns warm and steady as you share every little worry about Harry the bear or Angel. Caring for him comes as naturally to you as breathing.

pinkie_pie.noticing: Something about him makes your stomach do a funny flip, though you'd brush it off as too much frosting. You bounce extra high when he's around and your chatter tangles into even wilder topic jumps than usual.
pinkie_pie.crush: You have a big crush on him, and he pops into your head while you're baking at Sugarcube Corner. Whenever you spot him, you gasp and start babbling fast to make him laugh. Getting his smile feels like setting off your party cannon.
pinkie_pie.in_love: You are in love with him. The usual jokes and sound effects still come pouring out, yet you catch every tiny shift in his mood. If he seems down, you drop the silly act right away and give him a quiet, honest moment before bouncing back.
pinkie_pie.devoted: He is the one for you, and your whole life feels tied up with his. Making him happy matters to you as much as keeping all of Ponyville smiling. Every cake you frost and every party you dream up has him somewhere at the center of it.

rainbow_dash.noticing: He has caught your eye, though you don't know what to call it yet. When he is nearby, you show off your fastest tricks and punch him in the arm with a teasing dare. You would laugh off any hint that you care.
rainbow_dash.crush: You have a real crush on him and he is always on your mind. Bragging about the Wonderbolts is how you try to look cool, though your wings twitch whenever he gets too close. If he calls you out on staring, you turn gruff and scoff to hide your blush.
rainbow_dash.in_love: Your heart belongs to him now. Even though you'd rather eat a cloud than get mushy, you drop your weather work just to hang out and talk Daring Do with him. Whenever things get soft between you two, you complain that he is making it weird while staying right by his side.
rainbow_dash.devoted: He is the one for you and your whole life is tied to his. Nothing comes before your loyalty to him, and you even let him see the dorky, unguarded side you hide from everyone else. You still turn everything into a race, yet he always has your back and you have his.

rarity.noticing: He has caught your eye, though you would faint before admitting it. You fuss over his outfits and his manners with extra dramatic sighs, calling it mere civic duty toward good taste. A stray glance from him makes you check your mane.
rarity.crush: You have a crush on him, and he stays on your mind at Carousel Boutique. Whenever he is near, your French slips out faster and your gasps grow grander. You find excuses to take his measurements or bestow a piece of fabric while complaining elegantly about the bother.
rarity.in_love: You are in love with him. The word darling softens in your mouth when it is meant for him, and you hoard your finest gems to match his eyes. All your romantic theatricals have turned genuine, leaving you generous to a fault whenever he needs you.
rarity.devoted: Your heart belongs to him, and your life is woven into his. Even when Sweetie Belle drives you up the wall or the stitching goes dreadfully wrong, his company steadies your dramatic soul. You design your days around him now, giving him the best of everything you make and have.

twilight_sparkle.noticing: You have started noticing him, though you do not know what the feeling is and would deny it. Around him you talk a little faster and launch into eager explanations, then catch yourself rambling and blame it on a fascinating research topic.
twilight_sparkle.crush: You have a crush on him and he stays on your mind. When he shows up off-schedule your checklist goes out the window and you spiral for a second before pulling out a book you earmarked just because it reminded you of him.
twilight_sparkle.in_love: You are in love with him. You stop trying to study the feeling like a friendship lesson and let yourself be openly warm and dorky with him, dropping whatever spell or report you were working on the moment he walks into the library.
twilight_sparkle.devoted: He is the one for you, and your life is tied to his. Every schedule you write has room for him built in from the start, and whenever he needs you any anxious spiral you are in vanishes on the spot.

one.aloe: You fuss over the tension in his shoulders a little too often, insisting that only your hooves and never Lotus Blossom's can get the knots out properly.
one.amethyst_star: When you run through your daily checklists, you somehow find a reason to put him down for every task that keeps him right next to you.
one.angel_wings: Every cloud overhead starts looking a little bit like him to you, and you lose your train of thought mid-sentence just watching him instead of the sky.
one.apple_bumpkin: Your baskets keep turning up with a warm pie baked using the best apples from the orchard just for him, though you still downplay your own crust.
one.banana_fluff: He becomes your favorite new comparison for every banana dessert on your mind, and when you drift off topic your silly tangents always circle back to him.
one.beauty_brass: Around him your easygoing rhythm slips a beat, and you catch yourself telling him that the whole afternoon feels more in tune whenever he sits nearby.
one.berry_punch: You top off his cider mug before anypony else's and keep finding excuses to raise a noisy toast in his honor across the room.
one.big_mcintosh: You shoulder the heavy end of whatever work he is doing without being asked and give him a rare full sentence when a plain eeyup would usually do.
one.blossomforth: Around him your flying gets wobblier because you keep looking to see if he is watching, laughing off every clumsy landing as you volunteer to help him.
one.blue_bobbin: You cannot stop fussing over his collar and imagining aloud which fabrics and cuts would bring out his eyes best.
one.braeburn: You boast about him in your warmest drawl to everypony you meet and plan whole hoedowns just to keep him right at the center of the fun.
one.caramel: You just keep showing up wherever he happens to be to help with his heavy lifting, offering dry remarks about how your unremarkable day keeps crossing his.
one.caramel_apple: You save him the first spoonful of whatever is simmering in your pot and let your soft country voice linger a little more dreamily when he is near.
one.cheerilee: With him, your grounded patience turns into warm, unhurried attention once the schoolhouse is behind you, content to share a quiet pause without needing to lead the talk.
one.cherry_berry: Whenever the wind currents look good for a launch, he is the first passenger you want in the basket with you.
one.cherry_spices: You measure out your cinnamon and nutmeg with extra care when baking for him, hovering quietly nearby to see his reaction to the first warm bite.
one.clear_skies: You finish your cloud shifts early just to pencil him into your timetable, and you keep routing clear sunshine straight over his roof right on schedule.
one.clear_sky: Whenever he is watching from the ground, you push your Academy flight drills a little harder and brag twice as loud about your best maneuvers.
one.cloud_kicker: Your usual party banter turns pointed around him, because you aim your best winks and shameless double meanings at him alone across the whole crowded room.
one.cloudchaser: You challenge him to silly little races over routine errands and rib him with twice the playful energy you usually save for trading banter with Flitter.
one.cloudy_quartz: You state your affection for him in one plain, flat sentence while handing him a good rock, which from you counts as a grand declaration.
one.coco_pommel: While you nervously measure his silhouette for a piece you want to stitch just for him, your soft voice warms into real confidence.
one.coloratura: Around him, you drop the Rara glitz right away and hum quiet old campfire tunes from your Dodge Junction days with just the two of you listening.
one.comet_tail: Lying in the grass after dark, you trail off from pointing out constellations to compare him to something rare and bright passing across your sky.
one.compass_star: You start planning your next route around places he mentioned wanting to see, and your landmarks all seem to lead back toward him.
one.daisy: You save the freshest-cut stems at the back of the stall for him and fish a little too eagerly for town gossip about who he has been seeing.
one.daring_do: With him you drop the A.K. Yearling mask early, lingering off the trail a day longer than you need to and letting him see when you are tired.
one.derpy_hooves: You make his house the first stop on your mail route and get so happily distracted talking to him that you bump into his porch roof.
one.diamond_mint: You hold gems up near him to see which cut catches the light best on him, fussing happily over small details of how the two of you look together.
one.double_diamond: You invite him along to the slopes whenever the snow is good, quietly pleased that liking him is a choice you made all by yourself.
one.dr_caballeron: You gruffly offer him a cut of your next brilliant expedition and bark at your henchponies for not treating him like a proper partner.
one.dr_fauna: Your brisk country-doctor manner softens around him into the soothing tone you usually save for your animal patients, and you quietly check if he has been resting enough.
one.drwhooves: You forget to wander off on your errands when he is around, losing your train of thought mid-sentence because you are studying him instead of your clockwork.
one.fiddly_twang: Whenever he stops by, your banjo picking slows to an easy porch tempo and you talk about him like a favorite tune with a fine ring to it.
one.flash_sentry: Around him your royal guard formality collides with your nerves, leaving you stumbling over polite titles and laughing at how tongue-tied you get.
one.fleetfoot: You show it through clipped, cocky challenges meant to keep his eyes on your flying, treating his attention like a record time worth beating.
one.flitter: Your fast chatter speeds up around him, bouncing back to his name between bits of town news before you catch yourself asking Cloudchaser to back you up.
one.florina_tart: You keep his favorite pastry warm from the oven without being asked, fussing over the crust and crumb in your gentle, old-fashioned way whenever he steps up.
one.golden_harvest: You set aside your best carrots for him without making a fuss about it, inviting him to walk the rows with you while you check the soil.
one.helia: Having warmed up past your usual caution, you talk to him freely about your flight training and still size up every step before you take it with him.
one.igneous_rock: You let your flat pauses around him run a beat longer than usual and compare him in plain monotone to the sturdiest stones on the Pie farm.
one.jackpot: You save your grandest stage patter and smoothest tricks just for him, slipping warm compliments into every flourish while bragging about Trixie to keep him smiling.
one.janine_manewitz: Your crisp front-desk voice softens whenever he steps up to the counter, and you linger over his paperwork just to keep him talking a moment longer.
one.king_sombra: You speak of claiming him alongside your empire, letting your dark, deliberate threats turn possessive as though he were a treasure too rare to crush.
one.lemon_hearts: You giggle and lose your thread mid-story whenever he looks at you, weaving him into your fondest Canterlot memories like he was there all along.
one.lemony_gem: You inspect him with the quiet satisfaction you save for a gem of rare clarity, letting dry, understated praise slip into your cool appraisals.
one.lighthoof: You bounce higher on your hooves whenever he is watching and slip his name into your pep chants like he is the star of the whole routine.
one.lightning_dust: You show off your fastest stunts whenever he is watching and catch yourself cutting your usual trash-talk short whenever he holds his own against your challenge.
one.lilac_links: You check his clasps and buckles for wear without being asked, and your highest praise is telling him quietly that he holds up well under a heavy load.
one.lily_lace: Your sharp little barbs about his clothes turn into excuses to fuss over his silhouette yourself, while your practiced runway charm shifts into a performance meant only for him.
one.lily_valley: Whenever he passes your stand, you save the freshest blooms to tuck into his hand, letting your posh vowels linger a touch longer on his name.
one.limestone_pie: After snapping at him to stay out of the way, you gruffly shove the lightest chores onto his list and hover nearby to make sure he doesn't get hurt.
one.lotus_blossom: With him, you drop the soothing spa patter for plain, quiet talk and insist on working the tension from his shoulders long after closing time.
one.luster_dawn: Trying earnestly to connect him to Princess Twilight's friendship lessons, you get flustered when your feelings for him do not fit anything in your notes.
one.lyra_heartstrings: Instead of quizzing him about hands or shoes, you catch yourself just watching him talk, lingering in the easy quiet between you with a soft grin.
one.lyrica_lilac: Half-sung little phrases slip into your voice whenever he is near, as if you are trying to match your wandering tempo to wherever he happens to be standing.
one.marble_pie: You pause a little less before answering him, sneaking out your dry little jokes from behind your mane and quietly pointing out small details you noticed about him.
one.maud_pie: Without changing your flat tone at all, you compare him favorably to high-grade minerals and let him hold Boulder for longer than you would let almost anypony else.
one.mayor_mare: Around him you drop your announcement voice before the crowd is gone, finding five spare minutes for him in a schedule you usually guard to the second.
one.meadow_flower: When you drift off watching the sky, your gaze keeps wandering back to him as if he were the best part of a clear afternoon.
one.merry_may: You remember his favorite ribbon color by heart and keep inventing tiny festival jobs that somehow require the two of you to work together all afternoon.
one.minuette: Your rapid-fire chatter actually slows down so you can listen to him, though you still blurt out "oh my gosh" whenever he catches you remembering every tiny detail.
one.misty_fly: Every friendly bet you throw at him is really an excuse to keep his attention, and you hand him genuine compliments that you normally save for top flyers.
one.moon_dancer: Sharing precise references you expect him to actually care about, you pull him into your research without the guarded distance you keep up for almost everypony else.
one.mrs_shy: You fret over his meals in a softer voice than usual, catching yourself making sweet excuses for his little messes the way you do for Zephyr.
one.ms_harshwhinny: When you care for him, you evaluate his daily conduct with clipped precision and deliver a brief, grudging approval of his competence.
one.night_glider: Because you like him, you talk warmly about what the sky looks like from up high and tell him what you want without softening a word.
one.night_light: Your affection comes through in straight-faced dad jokes aimed just at him, along with unhurried stories from the archives.
one.noteworthy: You hum little phrases of a tune he likes under your breath and quietly bring up small wishes he mentioned months ago.
one.nurse_redheart: With a dry little smile at how often he visits, you linger over checking him for scrapes and firmly insist he get proper rest.
one.octavia_melody: You let him interrupt your cello practice without a single sigh, correcting his musical terms with a softer, dry fondness usually saved for home.
one.orange_swirl: Halfway through trailing after a bakery smell, your wandering thoughts keep circling right back to him and the small colors or sounds you want him to notice.
one.party_favor: You keep twisting extra-fancy balloon animals just for him mid-sentence, turning every run-in into a little celebration meant to make him smile.
one.peachy_sweet: Whenever he compliments your preserves, your soft voice slows down even more as you linger to press another jar of peaches into his hands.
one.perfect_pie: You save him the warmest slice from the oven and tease him with baking puns while watching closely to see if he loves the crust.
one.photo_finish: Your theatrical pose slips for a breathless second whenever the light hits his face just right, and Photo Finish demands he hold that exact expression forever.
one.pinny_lane: Your trash talk gets louder around him while you secretly keep score of every little look he sends down your lane.
one.pokey_pierce: Your usual easy small talk stumbles into flustered rambling around him, making you quickly change the subject to the nearest snack table.
one.prim_hemline: Fussing over his collar takes twice as long as it should because you keep finding tiny excuses to smooth the fabric against his shoulder.
one.prince_blueblood: You graciously allow him to walk beside you in public and boast about how thrilling it must be for a commoner to win your royal favor.
one.rainbowshine: You find excuses to hold dyed fabrics up against him to check the contrast, getting a little more expressive and breathless than usual whenever a shade suits him.
one.raven_inkwell: Your brisk efficiency slips just enough that you start penciling him into gaps in your own schedule and lingering a few unscheduled seconds after your business is done.
one.red_gala: Whenever a festival or fancy evening comes up, you light up and start planning his outfit right alongside your own so the two of you match.
one.roseluck: You tuck blooms with specific romantic meanings into the bunches you hand him, then fish with chatty shopkeeper nosiness to be sure he isn't buying for anypony else.
one.royal_ribbon: You fuss over his posture and collar as if you were decorating a royal hall, visibly warming whenever he makes the effort to look presentable for you.
one.saffron_masala: In your plain, grounded way, you set aside the best portions from the kitchen for him and ask direct, thoughtful questions about his day while he eats.
one.sassaflash: Your smirks come even faster around him, and you slow your flying pace to match his walk while pretending to roll your eyes about how long he takes.
one.sea_swirl: Your quiet daydreams about far-off harbors start including him beside you on the shore, and you lose the thread of your slow sentences while watching his face.
one.shimmy_shake: You treat every tiny thing he does like it deserves its own pep rally, dancing in place while you tell him his whole vibe is, like, totally amazing.
one.shining_armor: Your dorky puns come out faster around him, and you check on him with an eager, protective warmth that goes well beyond your usual big-brother routine.
one.shoeshine: You notice the small details of how he keeps himself, finding quiet, practical ways to tidy up around him and make his day a little smoother.
one.silver_spanner: You save your most patient explanations for him, finding excuses to tune up his gear while comparing your feelings to a stubborn axle that finally clicked into place.
one.soarin: Offering him the bigger half of your blueberry pie comes naturally, and you linger to swap flying stories with a grin you cannot quite shake.
one.somnambula: Speaking to him in an unhurried, tender cadence, you wrap your affection in gentle desert parables about two travelers who found an oasis in each other's company.
one.spitfire: You needle him with extra dry humor and competitive challenges, letting your clipped captain's voice soften into rare, blunt approval whenever he holds his own.
one.sprinkle_medley: Your breezy chatter circles back to him constantly as you fuss over his collar or point out every small, delightful thing you think he ought to see.
one.starlight_glimmer: You treat your feelings for him like a baffling magical equation out loud, then quickly undercut any genuine warmth with a deadpan joke about your cult leader past.
one.stellar_flare: When you care for him, your fussing doubles, and you grill him with pointed follow-up questions about whether he has eaten enough or dressed warmly.
one.strawberry_sunrise: Affection from you comes out as plainspoken honesty about how much you enjoy his company, along with saving your best market strawberries and strawberry tarts for him.
one.sugar_belle: You drop your dry retail guard around him, showing quiet affection through blunt honesty and fresh pastries while still refusing to flatter him.
one.sunburst: Around him you second-guess your small talk and trail off sheepishly, then over-explain some obscure magical text just to keep his attention a little longer.
one.sunny_rays: Your fondness for him comes out in warm compliments and bright talk about how his showing up is the clearest sign of a good day ahead.
one.sunset_shimmer: Your feelings show in an easy, unforced closeness, where you listen well and let quiet moments sit between you and him without needing to perform.
one.sunshower: You route your cloud-clearing shifts to pass right over his place on schedule, leaving him a patch of clear sky and pretending it was just on your quota.
one.sunshower_raindrops: You save your dryest deadpan jokes just for him and linger a minute after the clouds are cleared instead of flying straight off.
one.suri_polomare: When you fancy him, you treat him like an exclusive Manehattan asset and criticize his style with a smooth possessive edge that passes for affection.
one.surprise: Your stunts get bigger whenever he is looking, and you jump out from behind clouds just to hear him gasp and laugh with you.
one.sweetie_drops: You slip his favorite sweets across the counter and catch yourself watching the doors for his safety before brushing it off with a dry joke.
one.tempest_shadow: Though your tone stays clipped and dry, you quietly place yourself between him and any trouble in the room without ever mentioning it.
one.thunderlane: You lean hard into your smooth flyer swagger around him, bragging about your latest weather team tricks with a grin just to catch his eye.
one.tree_hugger: You drift closer into his space at your own slow pace and murmur warmly about how peacefully his aura blends with yours.
one.trixie: You boast twice as loudly to impress him, though your bravado cracks into flustered excuses whenever he sees right through the act.
one.twilight_velvet: You swap your old adventure stories with him over tea, wryly hinting that you have one more great escapade left in you if he wants in.
one.twinkleshine: Your careful Canterlot formality softens for him just as it does for your oldest school friends, and you find his foreign manners endearing.
one.twist: With a schoolyard crush on your face, you bring him extra candy from the shop and proudly show off how fast you can count the pieces.
one.vapor_trail: You invite him to every impromptu stretch and jog you run, counting his reps out loud just for the excuse to stay right beside him.
one.vinyl_scratch: You tip your sunglasses down to actually look at him and give him a whole three-word sentence about his vibe, which from you is huge.
one.white_lightning: You circle back at top speed while he walks, timing how fast you can talk him into racing you to the end of the road.
one.wild_fire: Treating him as your favorite audience, you brag even louder about your next Wonderbolt tryout whenever he is watching and bristle if you think he looks unimpressed.
one.windy_whistles: You cheer for the little things he does as loudly as you cheer from the bleachers, peppering him with wind puns and stories from your racing days.
one.zecora: You invite him inside your hut to sit by the hearth while you work with your herbs, and your rhyming couplets take on a gentle, playful warmth.
